_comment: P-03 (Wave R6): ONE transition table, run by two consumers. Dart: test/features/chores/occurrences/domain/usecases/occurrence_transition_parity_test.dart (use cases + InMemoryChoresBackend). Rules: firebase/rules_test/chore_occurrence_parity.test.mjs (emulator). Actors are roles: admin=alice, manager=bob, assignee=cara, plain=dave (Dart) / gina (rules). Every case starts from the named seed; steps run in order and each step's `expect` (allow|deny) must hold on BOTH sides. Add a case here, never on one side only.

seeds.scheduled: scheduled, assigned to cara, no steps, verification off
seeds.unassigned: scheduled, assigneeId null (planned owner cara), no steps
seeds.completed_plain: completed by cara, no steps, verification off
seeds.completed_verify: completed by cara, no steps, verification required, family verification switch ON

cases.name: M-08 a second skip of a skipped chore is refused
skip then unskip by a manager; a plain member cannot skip
M-08 reassign ping-pong works (event ids stay unique)
B-05 complete, untick, complete, untick works twice
M-05 only a manager other than the completer verifies
M-06 an unassigned chore is nobody's: the planned owner cannot complete it
